description: Read full pages or search exact text in the read-only Narev documentation filesystem. Discover paths with tree / -L 2 and read .mdx files with head or cat. Use search_narev_docs for broad questions. OpenAPI specs are under /openapi. Calls are stateless and output is capped at 30 KB, so use targeted reads.

command.description: A shell command to run against the virtualized documentation filesystem (e.g., `rg -il "keyword" /`, `tree / -L 2`, `head -80 /path/file.mdx`).

name: query_docs_filesystem_narev_docs
title: Query documentation filesystem
